indicator.zero_range_policy: Preserve published division and pandas rolling behavior: no fillzero repair; NaN suppresses both comparisons
indicator.zero_volume_policy: No source guard for a zero rolling volume denominator; retain nonfinite behavior and do not create signals by repair
indicator.dependency_pin_caveat: Inspected port dependency pin, not a dependency version declared by the strategy file

default_provenance.signal_flags: StrategyResolver defaults; IStrategy declares annotations without corresponding assigned values

derived_long_spot_equations.assumptions: Single fully filled long, leverage1, no borrowing/funding, entry and exit proportional quote fees, unchanged amount
derived_long_spot_equations.entry_price_symbol: E = actual average entry fill, not signal close
derived_long_spot_equations.native_trigger: round(net_roi,8) > 0.01; equality does not satisfy min_roi_reached
derived_long_spot_equations.native_backtest_boundary_fill: Once ROI condition reached at candle bound, backtester derives close_rate_for_roi; surrounding special-case/gap/candle logic also applies
derived_long_spot_equations.native_stop_precision: Long stop rounded UP to configured price precision/tick; actual initial stop then persists without trailing/custom stop
derived_long_spot_equations.cost_caveat: Extra spread/slippage/impact assumptions must be accounted once, separately and consistently; source minimalROI is fee-aware, not guaranteed net profit after all execution burden

native_exit_behavior.source_collision: CMF<0 and CMF>0 cannot both be true for same finite CMF; NaN makes both false
native_exit_behavior.temporal_caveat: Reason list priority is engine semantics, not proof of actual market event order or queue fills

Declare5m-to8h adaptation and full past-only warmup

Specify actual-fill protection activation and fee-reserved stake without future-price sizing
Preserve close-completed signal generation and define exact next-minute activation
Specify whether protection active before queued signal exit at same opening; conservative stop-first differs from native reason priority and must be labelled
Specify strict versus inclusive ROI threshold and precision explicitly
Retain gap,dual-touch,rejection and segment-ending censor accounting
Freeze costs,controls,acceptance gates and untouched future confirmation before outcomes
